Office of the Procurement Executive U.S. DEPARTMENT of STATE

SINGLE SOURCE JUSTIFICATION NOT EXCEEDING THE SIMPLIFIED ACQUISITION THRESHOLD SECTION 1: IDENTIFICATION OF THE AGENCY AND THE CONTRACTING ACTIVITY

Department of State Contracting Activity ☒ Overseas Post <Islamabad> Requiring Activity <Embassy Islamabad 4th of July/Freedom 250 Planning Committee>

SECTION 2: NATURE AND/OR DESCRIPTION OF THE ACTION BEING APPROVED

Approval is requested to award on a sole source basis to <Abdullah Catering & Tent Services, Pakistan> for the supplies and/or services described in Section 3 on behalf of the Requiring Activity.

SECTION 3: DESCRIPTION OF SUPPLIES/SERVICES REQUIRED TO MEET THE AGENCY'S NEEDS

The requirement is to provide <Event Planning Management and Design services> at <U.S Embassy Islamabad, Pakistan>. The estimated value for the entire period of performance is $<70,000>, including options. These supplies/services require that <Event Planning, Management and Design Services>. This will allow the Office of < Embassy Islamabad 4th of July/Freedom 250 Planning Committee> to accomplish <Hosting Mission Pakistan's Freedom 250 event on June 4, 2026>.

As part of this requirement the following services will be obtained:

1. Stage, Backdrops & Branding

2. Lighting, Cooling & Electrical

3. Audio, Music & Sound, Visual Systems & SMD Screens

4. Decorations & Installations

5. Entertainment & Performances To ensure consistency in quality, color, and thematic flow a design/event company was recommended and sought out to be the single point of contact and provide a turnkey solution that could independently serve a single point of contact on the management and implementation of the five sub-listed services and requirements noted above.

SECTION 4: IDENTIFICATION OF THE STATUTORY AUTHORITY PERMITTING OTHER THAN FULL AND OPEN COMPETITION

Office of the Procurement Executive U.S. DEPARTMENT of STATE In accordance with Federal Acquisition Regulation (FAR) 13.106-1(b)(1), the Contracting Officer has deemed only one source reasonably available based on the following:

☒ Urgency ☒ Other <Monetary and Schedule Impact to the Government that cannot be mitigated through other means>

SECTION 5: DEMONSTRATION THAT THE PROPOSED CONTRACTOR'S UNIQUE QUALIFICATIONS OR THE NATURE OF THE ACQUISITION REQUIRES USE OF THE AUTHORITY CITED

When the Iran/U.S. Conflict occurred, all normal business came to a halt including our ability to do proper market research. Once the hostilities had lessoned, the amount of time to conduct the proper research had passed. Revel had recently been used for a separate event at the Embassy, so it was decided to use them again for the Freedom 250 event.

Urgency impact is due to multiple regional tension impacting acquisition and planning operations to include preparations for two VPOTUS events within one month that absorbed post capacity to independently manage this event.

Monetary and Schedule impact that will be incurred will be the loss of services of a US Airforce Band that was scheduled about 8 months prior to this event date as the core entertainment element. There is no other time available as the Air Force Band is already scheduled and obliged to support other events in the region.

Proposed vendor has performed services at the U.S. Embassy Islamabad supporting quasi-official event services (not subject to FAR and Department Acquisition processes) and is known to be able to support events of 150-200 people and is able to mobilize the requisite goods and services in the time frame available to the Mission.

SECTION 6. DETERMINATION BY THE CONTRACTING OFFICER THAT THE ANTICIPATED COST TO THE GOVERNMENT IS FAIR AND REASONABLE

By signing the justification, the Contracting Officer makes a determination that the price to the Government is anticipated to be fair and reasonable.

Office of the Procurement Executive U.S. DEPARTMENT of STATE

All reviews and approvals should be completed in the order listed unless otherwise authorized or required.
